name: items
meaning: node array of this menu, loaded into g_menuPages by Menu_SetCurrent (e.g. 0x6dedf8 for g_pauseMenu, 0x6de104 for the confirm menu)

name: count
meaning: nodes in use; incremented directly through g_curMenu+4 by Menu_AddItems/Menu_AddPage, zeroed by 0x542d98 for the pause menu

name: capacity
meaning: size of items[]: 50 for g_pauseMenu/g_pausedMenu, 4 for the confirm menu, n+2 in 0x539199. Only 0x542d98 reads it (memset capacity*8); the add functions never check it

name: lastCursor
meaning: saved g_menuLastCursor (node that had focus last frame)

name: curPage
meaning: saved g_menuCurPage: index of the open page, whose children are the listed entries

name: prevPage
meaning: saved g_menuPrevPage: page left last, receives UNFOCUS in Menu_NotifyPageChange

name: unused10
meaning: zero in every initialiser (0x5390e9, 0x539199, .data 0x57c138); not read by the menu engine. The record is 0x14 bytes because the builders copy 5 dwords
